posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina wished director Rohit Shetty on his birthday amid ongoing rift rumors, and was spotted at Mumbai airport in a 'TIRED' tee after returning from her NYC trip with Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's upcoming film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali and Vedang Raina is generating massive buzz, with the trailer and new track 'Kya Kamaal Hai' winning fans over.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia returned from Cannes 2026 with Ranbir Kapoor and was trolled for wearing a 'TIRED' t-shirt at the airport. She's also confirmed for Koffee With Karan Season 9 and is rumored for Tumbbad 2.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka is currently filming SS Rajamouli's epic 'Varanasi' alongside Mahesh Babu, set for an April 2027 release — marking her biggest Indian cinema comeback in years.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's upcoming film 'King' is battling AI-generated leaks with heightened security, while reports suggest a possible reunion with Farah Khan for 'Main Hoon Na 2'.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena proudly celebrated son Taimur's Taekwondo achievement and shared a heartfelt family moment, while also being spotted at Karan Johar's star-studded birthday bash.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in the mythological drama 'Mahavatar', and announced 'Chhoti Stree' — an animated prequel exploring Stree's backstory before Stree 3.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's 'Raka' and SRK's 'King' as she manages her pregnancy. She exited 'Kalki 2', with Sai Pallavi stepping in as replacement.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer faces an FWICE non-cooperation ban over his exit from 'Don 3', while 'Dhurandhar 2' nears ₹1,150 crore net in India and became the biggest Indian grosser in the UK at £4.39 million.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 with multiple showstopping looks including a sapphire gown and white power suit, joined by daughter Aaradhya in a satin red gown for her 24th Cannes appearance.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika presented at the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo alongside Black Panther's Winston Duke, and her 'Cocktail 2' song 'Tujhko' with Shahid Kapoor just dropped.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Telugu production 'Maa Inti Bangaram' adds Gulshan Devaiah to the cast in a major Telugu debut, while she continues to enjoy a nature retreat in California.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun met RCB's Venkatesh Iyer after the IPL match against SRH and gifted his son a signed jersey. His collaboration with director Basil Joseph is confirmed — and it's not Shaktimaan.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's 'Peddi' hits theaters June 4 with AR Rahman's live concert in Bhopal drawing thousands. He apologized to Jasprit Bumrah after hilariously calling him a 'footballer' at the event.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's 'Dragon' first glimpse with Prashanth Neel smashed records with 64 million YouTube views in 24 hours. The period actioner is locked for a June 2027 global release.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi is all over the 'Peddi' promotions with Ram Charan — the 'Hellallallo' song is a viral hit, and the sports drama releases June 4 with North America advance sales crossing $393K.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romance 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya crossed ₹12 crore in its opening weekend and is getting a BOGO ticket push today to woo youth audiences.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down rumors about demanding changes in 'Toxic', calling them 'absolute nonsense'. She's also set to headline the Madhubala biopic produced by Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik was the target of yet another celebrity death hoax that went viral before being debunked. Meanwhile, 'Krrish 4' remains in limbo over VFX disagreements with the production team.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' trailer launched with father David Dhawan getting teary-eyed praising his son. The rom-com has been rescheduled to June 12 after Toxic's date shift.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya announced her 2026 'Unstoppable Tour' and 'All Hearts Tour' dates across the US, including stops in Boston. A viral TIME Person of the Year rumor was quickly debunked as a hoax.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman performed a massive live concert in Bhopal for the 'Peddi Ki Aawaz' event with Ram Charan, and praised Hans Zimmer's collaboration on the ₹4,000 crore 'Ramayana' soundtrack.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay turned 51 today as his final film 'Jana Nayagan' still awaits CBFC certification. Producer confirms the political actioner will release in theaters as soon as clearance arrives.
